title: Gemma-4-12B fp8 decode — plow vs vLLM margin, sm_120
gpu: RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition (sm_120, 188 SMs, 96 GB)
goal: >=10% decode TPOT margin vs vLLM at every ctx 1k..128k, fp8 weight-only e4m3 (stretch 15%)
verdict: MET at every rung: 12.4%..23.4% vs vLLM best config; stretch met at 4k..128k

plow_config.packet: PLOW_UNISEG=1 PLOW_FP8=1 PLOW_FP8_HEAD=1 PLOW_FP8_KV=1 gemma4 <model> 132096 pkt 188 (nsplit levers are the fp8-KV default: sliding ns16, full ns47)
plow_config.harness: gemma4_sm120_chat, vLLM seed-0 random ids p0, prefill buckets, 128 gen tok, warmup 16, n=112

headline_tpot_ms.note: base_ns24_ms = identical build/flags with the pre-campaign nsplit default (ns=24); argmax device==host AGREE at every point in both configs

full_layer_nsplit_align.what: kvh_full==1 signature: ns 24 (192 items ragged on 188 SMs) -> 47 (376 = exactly 2/block), gated on emit-time PLOW_FP8_KV

windowed_layer_nsplit_cap.what: sliding layers (window 1024): ns min(ns, win/64)=16; fixed intercept cut, ctx-independent

gf_full_raise.note: register tax on the whole megakernel hurts the fixed intercept; family-assets GF4+ns48 combo is ragged on 12B — use 47/94

gemv_smem_x_staging.note: PLOW_NV_GEMV_ARENA_K=15360: staged body byte-identical outputs, op test ok, but staging syncs + L1-carveout loss beat saved global-x traffic

gemv_f32_direct_dequant.note: dot8_fp8 (op_gemm.cuh:1648) already native cvt e4m3->half2->f32, no bf16 round-trip; the flash-arm round-trip was fixed by PLOW_FP8_FAST (beat26b), built into the ladder cubin

emit_time_weight_swizzle.note: GEMV weight reads fully coalesced (256B/warp-pass); network GEMV aggregate ~90% of fp8-byte ceiling; E4 shows fp8 cold-read ceiling binds, not dequant; upside <0.9ms vs layout-migration risk

gates.default_build_identity: flag-unset packets byte-identical (cmp bf16 + fp8-no-KV vs pre-change emitter); kernels untouched by shipped levers
gates.argmax_agree: device==host at all 7 points, both configs
gates.near_tie_class: step-0 logits BYTE-IDENTICAL ns24/ns47/GF8 at 1k & 4k (relL2=0); natural-prompt streams agree 18 tokens then flip (same class as rtx19-e3 fp8-KV drift ~21 tok); microbench merged-output maxdiff 0.0000 at every swept config
gates.post_merge_gpu_exec_stage1: plowc blob byte-identical; plowrt --features cuda,hf-tokenizer compiles; chat harness unaffected
